title: hieracium nigrescens subsp. subrhaeticum
intro: Hieracium nigrescens subsp. subrhaeticum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, contributing to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium nigrescens subsp. subrhaeticum are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit potential antitumor activity. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its pharmacological properties.
